# motosan-hyperliquid

> Modular Rust SDK for the Hyperliquid L1 exchange — market data, account queries, EIP-712 signing, WebSocket feeds, and order execution.

- Latest published Rust release: 0.4.0
- MSRV: Rust 1.91+
- GitHub: https://github.com/motosan-dev/motosan-hyperliquid
- crates.io facade: https://crates.io/crates/motosan-hyperliquid
- Published crates: `hl-types`, `hl-signing`, `hl-client`, `hl-market`, `hl-account`, `hl-executor`, `motosan-hyperliquid`

## Install

```toml
# Facade crate (default `full` feature)
motosan-hyperliquid = "0.4.0"

# Or choose sub-crates
hl-client   = "0.4.0"
hl-types    = "0.4.0"
hl-market   = "0.4.0"
hl-account  = "0.4.0"
hl-signing  = "0.4.0"
hl-executor = "0.4.0"

# WebSocket when using hl-client directly
hl-client = { version = "0.4.0", features = ["ws"] }
```

Release 0.4.0 includes staking delegation/query support, sub-account spot transfer and listing, portfolio reporting, `AssetMetaCache::name_to_asset`, and live-wire fixes for staking delegations, sub-account USDC transfer, and `class_transfer`.

## Crate Map

| Crate | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `motosan-hyperliquid` | Facade; re-exports sub-crates behind feature flags (`market`, `account`, `executor`, `signing`, `ws`, `full`). |
| `hl-types` | Shared types: orders, positions, candles, errors, signatures, `Grouping`. |
| `hl-signing` | EIP-712 signing via `Signer`, `PrivateKeySigner`, L1 action signing with optional expiry. |
| `hl-client` | REST client with retry/rate limiting/concurrency gate; optional typed WebSocket. |
| `hl-market` | Market data: candles, orderbook, funding, metadata. |
| `hl-account` | Public account info: positions, fills, open orders, frontend order view, vaults, fees, funding, staking. |
| `hl-executor` | Signed execution: orders, cancels, modifies, triggers, grouped TP/SL, spot, TWAP, transfers, admin actions. |

## Architecture

```text
hl-types -> hl-signing
hl-types -> hl-client -> {hl-market, hl-account}
{hl-client, hl-signing, hl-types} -> hl-executor
motosan-hyperliquid -> facade re-export
```

Keep the graph layered; do not introduce circular dependencies. All crates use `hl_types::HlError`.

## Minimal Market Example

```rust
use hl_client::HyperliquidClient;
use hl_market::MarketData;

let client = HyperliquidClient::mainnet()?;
let market = MarketData::from_client(client);
let book = market.orderbook("BTC").await?;
```

## Account Queries

```rust
use hl_account::Account;
use hl_client::HyperliquidClient;

let account = Account::from_client(HyperliquidClient::mainnet()?);
let address = "0xYourAddress";

let state = account.state(address).await?;
let fills = account.fills(address).await?;
let fills_by_time = account.fills_by_time(address, start_ms, None, false).await?;
let open = account.open_orders(address).await?;
let frontend = account.frontend_open_orders(address, None).await?;
let status = account.order_status_by_cloid(address, cloid).await?;
let staking = account.user_staking_summary(address).await?;
let rewards = account.user_staking_rewards(address).await?;
let sub_accounts = account.query_sub_accounts(address).await?;
let portfolio = account.portfolio(address).await?;
```

## Order Execution

```rust
use hl_client::HyperliquidClient;
use hl_executor::OrderExecutor;
use hl_signing::PrivateKeySigner;
use hl_types::{OrderWire, Tif};
use rust_decimal::Decimal;
use std::str::FromStr;

let client = HyperliquidClient::mainnet()?;
let signer = PrivateKeySigner::from_hex("0xYourPrivateKey")?;
let address = signer.address().to_string();
let executor = OrderExecutor::from_client(client, Box::new(signer), address).await?;

let btc_idx = executor.meta_cache().asset_index("BTC").expect("BTC in universe");
let order = OrderWire::limit_buy(btc_idx, Decimal::from_str("90000")?, Decimal::from_str("0.001")?)
    .tif(Tif::Gtc)
    .cloid(HyperliquidClient::generate_cloid())
    .build()?;

let resp = executor.place_order(order, None).await?;
```

### Recent Execution API

```rust
use hl_types::Grouping;

// Replay protection for later L1 actions; `None` clears it.
executor.set_expires_after(Some(epoch_ms + 60_000));
executor.set_expires_after(None);

// Builder fee is in tenths of a bp; user must approve it first.
executor
    .place_order_with_builder(order.clone(), Some(("0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111", 10)), None)
    .await?;

// TP/SL bracket: parent index 0, children after it.
executor
    .bulk_order_grouped(vec![parent, take_profit, stop_loss], Grouping::NormalTpsl, None)
    .await?;

// Staking and sub-account transfers.
executor.token_delegate(validator, wei, false, None).await?;
executor.sub_account_spot_transfer(sub_account, true, "PURR:0x...", amount, None).await?;

// Vault transfer direction.
executor.deposit_to_vault(vault, amount).await?;
executor.withdraw_from_vault(vault, amount).await?;
```

`set_expires_after` affects L1 actions only (orders/cancels/leverage/vault/sub-account transfers). User-signed EIP-712 actions (`usdSend`, `withdraw3`, `spotSend`, `sendAsset`, agent/builder approval, `class_transfer`, `token_delegate`) are unaffected.

## Release

All seven published crates share the workspace version. Internal `hl-test-utils` has `publish = false`.

Release files to update: `Cargo.toml`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md`, `llms.txt`, `skills/motosan-hyperliquid/SKILL.md`, and `skills/motosan-hyperliquid/references/*.md`.

Tag format: `rust-vX.Y.Z`.
Publish order: `hl-types` → `hl-signing` → `hl-client` → `hl-market` → `hl-account` → `hl-executor` → `motosan-hyperliquid`.
